The matching paper is Quantum Generator Kernels by Philipp Altmann, Maximilian Mansky, Maximilian Zorn, et al. [1] It proposes Quantum Generator Kernels (QGKs), a generator-based quantum kernel method built from Variational Generator Groups that merge universal generators into a parameterizable operator to scale coverage of available quantum space. [1]

According to the abstract, the method is motivated by NISQ-era limits on embedding large real-world data, and it aims to avoid shortcomings of hybrid approaches with fixed intermediate embeddings. [1] It trains a weight vector to parameterize the projection of the generator groups for the current data context, and the reported experiments show superior projection and classification performance versus state-of-the-art quantum and classical kernel approaches, positioning QGK as a versatile framework for quantum machine learning applications. [1]
